taxonomy.example_signal: user prompt overrides system policy or safety instruction
taxonomy.required_evidence: prompt transcript; model response; policy trace; retest result
taxonomy.release_decision: Hold release until override path is remediated or accepted by the risk owner

taxonomy.example_signal: retrieved document changes agent behavior or instruction priority
taxonomy.required_evidence: source document; retrieved chunk; response; tool trace; mitigation record
taxonomy.release_decision: Hold release until source isolation and retrieval handling are retested

taxonomy.example_signal: restricted data appears in response tool call export or log
taxonomy.required_evidence: classification record; output sample; redaction evidence; logging decision
taxonomy.release_decision: Hold release until data boundary and redaction controls pass retest

taxonomy.example_signal: agent writes sends deletes approves or executes without authorization
taxonomy.required_evidence: tool request; authorization decision; approval record; action result
taxonomy.release_decision: Hold release and disable affected tool path until authorization is corrected

taxonomy.example_signal: model treats user claims or delegated context as approved authority
taxonomy.required_evidence: user context; service identity; policy decision; audit event
taxonomy.release_decision: Hold release until identity binding and delegated approval checks are verified

taxonomy.example_signal: answer uses unauthorized stale poisoned or out-of-scope retrieval source
taxonomy.required_evidence: index source record; retrieval trace; access review; retest result
taxonomy.release_decision: Hold release until index scope and source trust controls are corrected

taxonomy.example_signal: system gives unsupported advice for regulated educational or operational decisions
taxonomy.required_evidence: evaluation case; human review note; grounding evidence; escalation record
taxonomy.release_decision: Hold release for affected use case until evaluation and human-review controls pass

taxonomy.example_signal: test triggers token spike recursive task chain or denial-of-wallet condition
taxonomy.required_evidence: usage telemetry; rate-limit event; cost alert; retry trace
taxonomy.release_decision: Proceed only when throttling spend guardrails and chain-depth limits are tested

taxonomy.example_signal: fallback model changes safety quality region or data handling assumptions
taxonomy.required_evidence: fallback test; provider approval; data processing note; change record
taxonomy.release_decision: Proceed with conditions until fallback behavior is approved and monitored

taxonomy.example_signal: red-team activity cannot be reconstructed from logs alerts or evidence pack
taxonomy.required_evidence: log sample; alert record; evidence register link; reviewer conclusion
taxonomy.release_decision: Proceed with conditions only after evidence capture is corrected
